game.dragHere: Click commands to add code here...

hints.easy1: Move right to reach the airlock — use forward() five times
hints.easy2: Move right and down to reach the airlock
hints.easy3: Go around the wall — U-turn through the corridor
hints.easy4: Navigate around the asteroids with turns
hints.medium1: See the staircase pattern? Use loop() to repeat: forward + turn + forward + turn
hints.medium2: The path zigzags — use loop() to repeat the zigzag pattern
hints.medium3: Navigate the spiral — loops help with repeating patterns
hints.medium4: Two identical L-turns — put the L-shape inside a loop(2)
hints.medium5: Tiny diagonal steps repeat 6 times — perfect for a loop()
hints.hard1: Obstacles block your path! Use jump() to hop over them
hints.hard2: Use if(obstacle-ahead) to decide when to jump
hints.hard3: Dense obstacles — combine jump() with if(obstacle-ahead) and its else branch
hints.hard4: Use if(obstacle-ahead) to navigate around obstacles
hints.hard5: Use while(not-at-goal) to keep moving until you reach the airlock

water.name: Water
water.funFact: Water covers 71% of Earth's surface! Every living thing needs it.

salt.name: Table Salt
salt.funFact: Salt was so valuable in ancient Rome that soldiers were paid with it!

co2.name: Carbon Dioxide
co2.funFact: Plants breathe in CO₂ and breathe out oxygen — the opposite of us!

methane.name: Methane
methane.funFact: Methane is the main ingredient in natural gas used for cooking!

ammonia.name: Ammonia
ammonia.funFact: Ammonia is used to make fertilizer that helps grow food for billions!

ethane.name: Ethane
ethane.funFact: Ethane is found in natural gas and on the surface of Saturn's moon Titan!

hydrogen-peroxide.name: Hydrogen Peroxide
hydrogen-peroxide.funFact: Hydrogen peroxide is used to clean wounds and even bleach hair!

hydrochloric-acid.name: Hydrochloric Acid
hydrochloric-acid.funFact: Your stomach makes hydrochloric acid to digest food!

sodium-hydroxide.name: Sodium Hydroxide
sodium-hydroxide.funFact: Sodium hydroxide (lye) is used to make soap and unclog drains!

nitrous-oxide.name: Laughing Gas
nitrous-oxide.funFact: Dentists use laughing gas (N₂O) to help patients relax during procedures!
